CREATE TABLE privacy_requests (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), customer_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, resolution TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE privacy_request_events (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES privacy_requests(id), actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL)
CREATE FUNCTION protect_privacy_request_events() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request history is immutable'; END; $$
CREATE TRIGGER privacy_request_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON privacy_request_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_privacy_request_events()
